NOT_COOLING.speech: Please look at the remote and check it shows the snowflake sign. If it shows a sun or a water drop, press the Mode button until the snowflake appears.
NOT_COOLING.evidence: The FL-18i cools only in COOL mode, shown by the snowflake symbol on the remote display.

NOT_COOLING.speech: Please set the temperature on the remote to 24 degrees. Then give the room about ten minutes to cool.
NOT_COOLING.evidence: Set a temperature below the room temperature; 24 degrees is recommended. Allow 10 minutes for the room to respond.

NOT_COOLING.speech: Please close the doors and windows of the room and draw the curtains. Is the room closed up now?
NOT_COOLING.evidence: Open doors, windows and direct sunlight reduce cooling noticeably.

WEAK_AIRFLOW.speech: Please press the Fan button on the remote until it shows the highest fan speed. Does more air come out now?
WEAK_AIRFLOW.evidence: Fan speed cycles through Low, Medium, High and Auto with the FAN button.

WEAK_AIRFLOW.speech: Please make sure no curtains or furniture are blocking the front of the AC. Only move things you can reach easily from the floor.
WEAK_AIRFLOW.evidence: Keep at least 30 cm clear in front of the indoor unit so air can flow freely.

REMOTE_ISSUE.speech: Please put two new AAA batteries in the remote. Does the remote screen light up now?
REMOTE_ISSUE.evidence: The remote uses two AAA batteries. A blank display means the batteries need replacing.

NOT_TURNING_ON.speech: Please check the wall switch for the AC is turned on. If it is on and the AC still won't start, I can arrange a demo technician visit.
NOT_TURNING_ON.evidence: The indoor unit needs its wall switch in the ON position.

WATER_LEAK.speech: Please turn the AC off with the remote and put a towel under the drip. I can arrange a demo technician visit to look at it.
WATER_LEAK.evidence: Water dripping from the indoor unit usually needs a service visit to clear the drain.

E1.speech: That code means the room sensor needs a reset. Please switch the AC off with the remote, wait one minute, then switch it on once.
E1.evidence: E1: room temperature sensor fault. Restart once with the remote; if E1 returns, call service.

E3.speech: That code means the AC needs a technician to look at it. Shall I arrange a demo technician visit?
E3.evidence: E3: outdoor unit protection. Do not restart repeatedly; arrange service.
